ينكسف (form VII)

# يَنْكَسِفَ (yankasifa) /jan.ka.si.fa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْكَسَفَ (inkasafa)
# يَنْكَسِفْ (yankasif) /jan.ka.sif/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْكَسَفَ (inkasafa)
